reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and it does most of this when I paste stuff in. I might poke at the free plan, but I'm not paying 99 euros a month for three 'managers' until I see them actually do something in my own tools.
objection: 'Connects to your CRM, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365...' is vague. If it doesn't plug into the exact tools we run, it's just another ChatGPT wrapper with a nicer name, and I still don't know what 100 credits buys me in real work.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it hooked into my actual CRM and inbox in a demo, doing a real week of follow-ups and posts without me copy-pasting, with a clear idea of how far 100 credits goes.
